cost_thresholds._comment: Thresholds applied to the platform's own estimated_cost_usd from adl_get_agent_metrics. Tune per-workspace. Lower thresholds = more findings per run.

tier_rules._comment: A model or alias is high-tier when its name contains none of the small_tier_markers. If an agent uses a high-tier model AND has avg_output_tokens < small_tier_threshold_output_tokens AND has at least min_runs_for_downgrade completed runs in 30d AND its bot manifest doesn't declare thinkLevel: high, recommend the alias in downgrade_alias_by_provider for that agent's own provider. The bot reasons in tokens; per-token prices live on the workspace rate card, never here.

company_glossary.tier_rules: Substring markers that identify a small tier within a provider's own model line, plus the alias to suggest per provider. No model ids and no prices.
company_glossary.overspec_candidate: Agent using a high-tier model (no small-tier marker in its name) with consistently low output tokens. A small-tier alias would likely suffice without quality regression.
company_glossary.runaway_agent: Agent with high run rate AND high failure rate. Likely retry-looping; pausing prevents the loop from amplifying cost.
company_glossary.stale_agent: Agent enabled but with zero runs in 30 days. Either disable or investigate why its trigger isn't firing.
company_glossary.schedule_mismatch: Agent firing more frequently than the data change rate of its entityTypesRead, wasted runs that produce 'no new records' findings.
company_glossary.estimated_cost_usd: The platform's own cost figure for a run window, computed from its rate table. The only dollar figure this bot uses.
